case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear Mr. Stadler,

Thank you for your offer and for the many years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies. We value it greatly and would like to find a fair solution for both sides.

Our data shows the following:

German producer prices for fasteners changed +1.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2594@2025-08, idx:PPI-C2594@2026-08).

Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

With this in mind, we would like to bundle the fastener kit with you as our one distributor. Longer contract terms give you planning certainty, and the options below offer faster or standard payment, depending on what suits you best:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.18; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.03; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

We hope one of these works for you and look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.

While we note the historical price stability of the specific hex bolts you mentioned, the comprehensive kit involves different components and market dynamics. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C.

We appreciate your proposal to bundle the fastener kit and welcome the 24-month contract term, which provides valuable planning certainty for both sides. Building on your 30-day payment terms and the extended contract duration, we can offer a revised price of EUR 5.53 per unit.

Our offer stands at a price of €5.53 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

We are glad you found our price history data sound. We understand that the kit involves different components, so here are the prices for two further parts of it:

Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

Between our two family companies, we would like a fair solution that works for both sides. These are our firm proposals:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.22; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.07; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.19; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A and Option B answer your interest in a longer-term partnership with different payment terms. We look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
